      "name": "Client Proof Row",

      "name": "FAQ Split Section",

    },

      "name": "Founder Testimonial Column",
      "role": "Social proof",
      "description": "Lay out three unboxed columns on #ffffff. Use 16px Saans Regular quote text at 24px line-height, then a compact attribution row with a circular 80px or 12px-cropped avatar, #000000 name, and #878787 role/company metadata."
